snippet.title: Frank Bruno's Boxing on the C64 (original loader all boxers and end screen)
snippet.description:
The game that I never saw through as a kid. I could only ever beat Canadian Crusher, the first one. I tweaked the code so that the opponents could be beat with one punch.

I also cut-out the annoying password codes you had to enter for each level (that were confusing to enter because of a different keyset) and the slow tape loading times. The disk version is faulty, btw, as the end screen is distorted.

Overall, this game is a real pain-in-the-ass but has some nice animation.
